name: Elf-Scorned
text: **Elf-Scorned**: Many half-elves, especially half-drow and half-Ekujae, are rejected by their elven parents and feel nothing but hatred and fear toward their inhuman ancestors. They gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls and a +2 dodge bonus to AC against elves. This racial trait replaces elven immunities and multitalented.
